summary: A resident's court challenge to petition pages gets the county to recheck and the candidate ends up under the number.
realLife: A county recorder's review of challenged petition signatures, many from unregistered people or voters outside the district, left a mayoral candidate short, and he withdrew before the court date.
sources: Yahoo News, mayoral candidate withdraws after signatures disqualified, April 2024: https://www.yahoo.com/news/glendale-mayoral-candidate-jamie-aldama-232803412.html
inGame: petition-short; a challenge step that sends the pages to the recorder

turns.pulledBy: a long margin over the required number
turns.writesBack: the candidate stays on the ballot

turns.turn: The count lands under the line
turns.pulledBy: a thin margin and a paid circulator firm
